interpretationDecisions.decision: The first retained reference changes revision 1 to revision 2: the video prints 623MK, but live history performs yellow medium PUNCH. Its command is 623MP. The ID, original clip bounds and all media remain unchanged; the other 15 original objects remain exact.

Near-corner lights are standing LK, LP, LP despite a crouching-light overlay. Raw Rush links crouching HP despite a generic printed HP. Only the performed SA1 ending is authored where an overlay offers SA1 or SA2.

Wind prerequisites are separate from follow-up costs. The three-Wind corner route spends one stock each on heavy Spire, OD Buster and OD Dive. Ordinary OD air-to-air specials and ordinary OD-Spire oki are explicitly no-Wind variants. Held OD Wind gains the Wind used later in that route.

The medium-Buster Rush bait and two shorter OD-DP punish routes visibly block Ryu OD Shoryuken. The longer raw-Rush double-cancel cash-out at619.55 instead punishes an OD Shoryuken that misses at the recorded spacing; its preceding jab/whiffed-low setup is stated separately. Bison Drive Reversal is a guarded Drive Reversal, not an OD special.
j.MP followed by j.MP is the same-jump target after an initial airborne Counter Hit. The grounded Buster follows after landing. These are tagged Air-to-air, not grounded Anti-air.
Blocked OD wind Spire begins standing pressure, not oki. Source +F labels describe advantage, not a prescribed wait. Exact holds, micro-walk distances and delays are not invented.

Raw Rush plus two cancel Rushes has a nominal seven-bar cost; the recording starts with a six-bar gauge and the final cancel enters burnout. It does not imply seven-bar capacity. Normal-health SA3 is distinguished from Critical Art.

Held-heavy Wind losing to DI is excluded. The short-hold take records an ordinary parry; it does not prove a universal Perfect-Parry counter. Unresolved safe-jump, reversal and printed/live jump-button candidates remain out of reviewed cards.
